checks: TCAA visitor guidance directs travelers to obtain an import permit for the drone and any accompanying spare parts. It describes temporary importation for travelers who will take the drone out again.
Tanzania; travelers carrying a drone into the country
Verify the accepted model, approval sequence, port procedures and re-export evidence. Flight authorization is separate.
TCAA guidance requires drone registration and flight authorization in Tanzania and calls for foreign operators to obtain their permits before arrival.
Tanzania; civil drone flight by visitors
Check operational category, pilot documents, site-specific airspace, and separate rules for protected areas or photography.
KCAA implementing standards provide for temporary import of a drone for private use for the period specified in the temporary import permit. KCAA must be notified when the drone is exported again.
Kenya temporary drone import for private use
Check the current permit procedure, customs requirements and the separate temporary operating permit.
CAAP distinguishes sports and recreational drone operations from commercial operations. Its registration guidance requires registration of noncommercial aircraft with gross weight of 7 kg or more.
Philippines; CAAP registration under the recreational and commercial distinction
Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines
Check current regulations, credentials and additional approval for the actual operation, and local restricted areas. Light-aircraft registration exemptions do not resolve flight or import rules.

SACAA distinguishes private operations under Part 101, hobbyist operations under Part 94, and other operations with separate requirements. It defines private use by the absence of a commercial outcome or gain.
South Africa; private or hobbyist flight classifications
Verify the current Part 101 provisions, operating limits, landowner permission, airspace and visitor circumstances. Classification does not establish customs treatment.
Chile's DGAC identifies a narrow DAN 91 recreational exception from advance flight authorization in populated areas, limited by aircraft material, weight up to 750 g, height and private location.
Chile Dirección General de Aeronáutica Civil
Check the current DAN 91 and DAN 151, current applicable editions and all conditions before applying the exception. Do not infer nationwide recreational permission.
ANAC guidance describes mandatory registration or inscription of covered recreational drones with maximum takeoff weight above 250 g.
Brazil; ANAC civil drone aircraft registration
Brazil Agência Nacional de Aviação Civil
Confirm current rules and visitor eligibility, foreign registration recognition, telecom homologation and separate airspace authorization.
ANATEL publishes a list of drone models ineligible for the cited declaration-of-conformity process for own-use homologation.
Brazil; telecom equipment conformity pathway for listed drone models
Verify the model and current ANATEL procedure. The list does not determine personal baggage admissibility, temporary admission, tax or required customs declarations.
Colombia's published RAC 100 adopts an open category for covered noncommercial unmanned flights. Its registration provision notes an exemption for aircraft weighing less than 200 g.
Colombia Unidad Administrativa Especial de Aeronáutica Civil
Check consolidated amendments, local flight limits and permissions, visitor access to registration, and separate import rules.
Argentina's ANAC cites RAAC Parts 100 through 102 for drone flight, with separate open and specific operating categories. The current framework superseded the previous 2019 rules.
Argentina Administración Nacional de Aviación Civil
Check the 2026 amendments, exact operating category and site limits, current registration and visitor requirements.
Costa Rica's civil aviation authority says recreational drones do not need registration and directs operators to its aeronautical notices for flight limitations.
Costa Rica; recreational registration under DGAC guidance
Costa Rica Dirección General de Aviación Civil
Check current AIC Series C, airport and national park limits, and whether a specific flight is classified as recreational.
Saudi GACA's Part 48 sets the registration and marking framework for covered unmanned aircraft and addresses exceptions such as aircraft registered under a different GACAR part.
Saudi Arabia; unmanned aircraft registration and marking under Part 48
Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation
Verify the current edition and whether a nonresident can qualify. Check authorization for the planned flight and equipment import separately.
CAAC announced mandatory national standards for real-name registration and activation and for identification of civil unmanned aircraft operations, effective 1 May 2026.
Mainland China civil unmanned aviation; standards and stated effective date
Check current UOM procedures, foreign passport verification, aircraft class, airspace and local filming rules. Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR have their own regimes.
